1 · Intro

When to use it.

Most of your reporting is running a report someone already built and reading the results correctly.

The key choices are the prompts you answer and the date you run it for.

Use this whenYou need to run an existing catalog report for your area and trust what it shows.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle BI. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • Date matters. A person hired next week will not appear on a report run as of today.
  • Results show only people within your data security.
  • Open item: confirm which standard HCM reports Vanderbilt expects HCMs to run and where they are stored.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: View Analytics, Reports, and Dashboards (opens in a new tab)

3 · Knowledge check

Check your understanding.

Three questions. You get feedback on each answer. All three right completes the course.

Q1A hire effective next Monday is missing from today's report. What is the most likely reason?

Q2You leave the department prompt blank. What should you expect?

Q3You need the same report for a different department. What should you do?

4 · Job aid

Keep it handy.

A one-page version of the steps and watch-outs. Print it or save it as a PDF.

HCM Academy job aid · Document Records & Reporting

Reporting 101

Use when: You need to run an existing catalog report for your area and trust what it shows. · System: Oracle BI (OTBI)

  1. Open Reports and Analytics and find the report.
  2. Answer the prompts.
  3. Set the as-of or effective date.
  4. Run the report and wait for results.
  5. Read the results with the prompts in mind.
  6. Rerun with new prompts instead of editing the report.

Watch-outs

  • Date matters. A person hired next week will not appear on a report run as of today.
  • Results show only people within your data security.
  • Open item: confirm which standard HCM reports Vanderbilt expects HCMs to run and where they are stored.
